_comment: The BASE layer. Copy this file to env.json, which is gitignored because it holds hostnames and credentials. Each top-level key is a stage; Ctrl+E cycles them and the active one is shown beside the tabs. Put here only what every project shares, plus anything a request at the top of the tree needs -- a project's own hosts belong in requests/<project>/env.json, which overrides this file key by key. A key starting with _ is a comment. Values may be strings, numbers or booleans; a number keeps the exact digits you wrote, so an id larger than a JavaScript float can hold is safe.
